name: Morgan's Plot
summary: Restless dead roam Morgan's Plot behind Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. Its ruined chapel and graves hold those who once belonged to Medivh's household.

sections.title: A Grave in the Shadow of the Tower
sections.body:
Behind Karazhan, Morgan's Plot lies against rocky slopes. A ruined chapel stands above crypts beneath the earth. Before Deadwind Pass fell into decay, the estate buried those who lived in the tower and on the nearby grounds.

After Medivh, the Last Guardian, fell, dark energies seeped into the earth. Restless dead drove away all normal life. Now the unliving wander among the headstones, where servants and figures from Karazhan's history lie buried.

sections.title: Resting Place of Guardians and Servants
sections.body: Medivh was buried at Morgan's Plot after the tragedy that shattered the tower. He was later resurrected before his return during the Third War. The crypts beneath the soil remain a mystery, and old arcane power and unquiet spirits weigh on the graveyard.

aliases: how to get to morgans plot
faq.answer: Morgan's Plot lies in southern Deadwind Pass, in a gloomy hollow directly behind Karazhan's high spire.

aliases: who is buried at morgans plot
faq.answer: Karazhan's household was buried in the graveyard and crypts. After Medivh fell, the Guardian himself was buried here.

faq.q: What threats can be found at Morgan's Plot?
faq.answer: Unlived residents and restless spirits haunt the chapel and grounds, roaming around the gravestones and crypt entrance.

angles.text: As a priest, you find defiled graves and roaming unliving at Morgan's Plot. They recall the corrupting taint left where the Guardian's dark fate unfolded.
As a mage, you know Dalaran regards Morgan's Plot with quiet dread. It holds the burial ground of those struck down during Medivh's tragic end.
